blocks.text: Setting up your workspace for media buying

As a media buyer, you likely keep a dozen tabs open. You can turn Google Sheets into a dedicated Mac app. Open Chrome, navigate to your sheet, and click the three-dot menu. Select Cast, Save, and Share, then pick Install page as app. This keeps your campaign data in a separate window on your macOS dock.

Speed matters when you are updating hundreds of rows of ad spend. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to open Find and Replace. Use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9 to hide rows you do not need to see right now. Use ⌘ + ⌥ + 0 to hide columns. If you forget a shortcut, press ⌘ + / to see the full list.

Media buyers often deal with massive exports. If your sheet slows down, check for too many complex formulas. Use Paste Special to keep values instead of recalculating live data. If you need to filter data, use the Data menu to create a filter view so you do not disrupt your team's view.
How to use Lazur with your spreadsheets

Lazur works where you work. When you are stuck, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where a setting is. Lazur will draw a circle around the menu item. If you need to write a quick campaign note, hold fn and dictate your thoughts directly into the cell. It saves you from constant switching between your email and your tracking sheet.

items: Not freezing the top row: Always use View > Freeze > 1 row so you can see your headers while scrolling.
Hardcoding values: Use cell references instead of typing numbers directly into formulas.
Ignoring revision history: If a formula breaks, click File > Version history to restore a working version.
Forgetting to share with view-only access: Check your permissions before sending reports to clients.

blocks.text: You can use Data > Split text to columns to fix messy UTM parameters. If you have duplicate rows from multiple platform exports, use Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates. This ensures your ROAS calculations are accurate and not inflated by repeated data points.

faq.question: Is there a native Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web-based app. You can create a PWA shortcut in Chrome to make it act like a desktop app.

faq.question: How do I see all keyboard shortcuts in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / while inside any Google Sheet to open the complete shortcut menu.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can ask it for help, dictate notes, or have it point out menu items while your browser is open.
